messages.text:
(The fog on Baker Street is so thick it won't lift. You stand on the doorstep of 221B; Watson pokes his head out of the window.)

"Holmes, what are you looking at?"

"London's fog descends at the most opportune moment."

**Choose how to begin:**
1. Step into Baker Street — start by checking the police station
2. Stay in the apartment and think — first sort out the clues you already have
3. Head straight to the orchard — follow the blurred photograph
